description: Create an iOS or Android app without the web UI. Returns the publishable key and a one-time app-scoped management key.

bundle_id.description: The iOS bundle id or Android package name, for example com.example.app, 3 to 255 characters.

device_matching_mode.description: Coverage mode. on (the API's default): maximum coverage, events of all eligible matches are sent. strict: events of verified matches only.

idempotency_key.description: Stable retry key for this exact mutation.

platform.description: The app's platform: iOS or Android.

store_url.description: The app's App Store or Google Play page URL.

timezone.description: The app's timezone, at most 64 characters. The API uses UTC when omitted.

name: create_app
title: Create an app
